stemMd: A shop buys items at 12 euros each and sells them at 17 euros each. Fixed monthly costs are 450 euros. What is the smallest number of items needed for a positive monthly profit?
explanationMd: Each sale contributes 5 euros toward fixed costs. Positive profit requires $5n-450>0$, so n>90 and the smallest whole number is 91.

distractorRationale.c: Gives the break-even count, not positive profit.
distractorRationale.a: Divides fixed costs by selling price rather than contribution.
distractorRationale.b: Divides fixed costs by purchase price.
